0.original: Teteroon appears to have finished his gift for Buscarron.

1.original: Teteroon has finally finished his gift for Buscarron. Deliver the special brand of Qiqirn beverage back to the eponymous proprietor of Buscarron's Druthers in the South Shroud.

2.original: Buscarron is delighted to receive the hard liquor brewed by his old friend. However, he is less delighted when he realizes it would be best to age it a year before finally cracking it open.

24.original: Deliver the Qiqirn firewater to Buscarron at Buscarron's Druthers.

48.original: Teteroon make firewater! Good, good firewater! You take to Buscaroon. Good firewater for good Buscaroon.

49.original: Tell Buscaroon no drink now. Tell put away one year. One year make best flavor.

50.original: <sigh> Teteroon hopes Buscaroon happy. Teteroon gives Buscaroon thankies. Many, many thankies. You tell Buscaroon.

51.original: Teteroon make big shop someday. Biggest shop in Eorzea. Make many, many sparklies. All thanks to good Buscaroon.

52.original: Ah, you've returned. Thank you for seeing Teteroon's belongings to him.<hex:02100103>...What's this? For me?

53.original: Qiqirn firewater! So he remembers my fondness for the drink, does he? Why that old... He... I... Aw, bloody hells! Who's cutting onions back there!?

54.original: He says to shelve it for a year, does he? Aye, that sounds about right. I hate to have to wait, but I reckon it'll be worth it. This stuff has an aroma and body unlike any other drink I know.

55.original: It's going to be a looong year. What say you come back then, friend? We'll see if we can't make it through this bottle together.
